title: L107 — THE HAND THAT KNOWS
_cellule: SETD (Sniper) · Miroir · Risk · regard=autres traders · présent · −−
voice: Two students draw the same setup. One releases clean — the other's hand shakes right before the click.
He finished the analysis two minutes ago.
Every extra check costs the price he was looking at, because the level he decided on has already been traded through.
He is not paying for certainty. He is paying the distance between the price he chose and the price he gets.
Hesitation is not free, it is priced in the fill. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.

caption:
Two students draw the exact same setup. One releases clean. The other's hand shakes right before the click.

The shake isn't in the analysis — that part was already finished. It's in the fear of being wrong where someone else can see it. An audience turns a decision into a performance, and performances can fail in front of people.

Hesitation is not free, it is priced in the fill.

Follow @kongrave_ — the mechanics nobody explains.
